verdict.rationale: DBOS documents cron-scheduled workflows whose schedules live in the database and can be created, paused, resumed, and deleted at runtime. Conductor and dbosctl can inspect and drive schedules. Nothing in the evidence describes overlap policies, and nothing explicitly shows upcoming runs, beyond generic schedule inspection. missing for 10: overlap/concurrency policies for scheduled runs, explicit visibility into upcoming scheduled runs, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a backend developer, I schedule workflows on cron expressions with overlap policies, pause/resume, and visibility into upcoming runs

citations.quote: You can schedule DBOS workflows to run on a cron schedule. Schedules are stored in the database and can be created, paused, resumed, and deleted at runtime.
inspect queues and schedules, drive schedules
